title: aquilegia ecalcarata var. micrantha
intro: Aquilegia ecalcarata var. micrantha, commonly known as the alpine columbine, is a perennial plant species within the Ranunculaceae family. This plant is known for its delicate, bell-shaped flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The health benefits of Aquilegia ecalcarata var. micrantha include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory health, and exhibit antioxidant properties, making it a valuable plant for therapeutic purposes. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are known to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antitumor activities.
